Theorem
[Perelman's no local collapsing] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0101 1. ch19:19.2\group Noncollapsing

For a finite-time Ricci flow on a closed manifold and a finite scale $\rho $, there is $\kappa >0$, depending only on the initial metric, the final time, and $\rho $, for which the flow is $\kappa $-noncollapsed below $\rho $.
